chat.cataclysm_primed_soul.ignis_prime.a: The Lord of Black Flame, Ignis Prime, has manifested...! Armor around is weakened!
chat.cataclysm_primed_soul.ignis_prime.h: Ignis Prime's wrath siphons the surrounding heat...! Armor and Toughness are heavily reduced!
chat.cataclysm_primed_soul.ignis_prime.p: The ultimate soul erupts! All protective enchantments burn to ashes...
tooltip.cataclysm_primed_soul.abyssal_as: §6 If you offer it to the Altar of Fire again, something might happen.
